description: Phase 1 Demo: Ownership Transfer Protocol. Generate a new standard-library module defining a stateful Ownership effect and five verified atoms. The generated file MUST follow the Stateful Effects documentation pattern from std/effects.mm and the exact state-machine syntax used by tests/test_order_state_machine.mm: `effect Ownership`, `states: [Idle, PendingTransfer, Transferred];`, `initial: Idle;`, and transitions `propose: Idle -> PendingTransfer`, `accept: PendingTransfer -> Transferred`, `cancel: PendingTransfer -> Idle`. Each atom MUST declare `effects: [Ownership];` plus explicit `effect_pre` and `effect_post` contracts. Atom bodies MUST use `perform Ownership.propose;`, `perform Ownership.accept;`, and `perform Ownership.cancel;` for primitive transitions. Cross-atom composition MUST strictly follow tests/test_modular_verification.mm: compose atoms by calling previous atoms in order and rely on their effect_pre/effect_post contracts. Do NOT invent new syntax; follow tests/test_order_state_machine.mm and tests/test_modular_verification.mm exactly.

atoms.name: propose_transfer
atoms.description: Propose a transfer to a new owner. This primitive operation moves Ownership from Idle to PendingTransfer.

atoms.name: accept_transfer
atoms.description: Accept a pending transfer. This primitive operation moves Ownership from PendingTransfer to Transferred.

atoms.name: cancel_transfer
atoms.description: Cancel a pending transfer and return to the idle owner state.

atoms.name: full_transfer
atoms.description: Cross-atom composition of propose_transfer then accept_transfer. The sequence proves Idle -> PendingTransfer -> Transferred.

atoms.name: propose_and_cancel
atoms.description: Cross-atom composition of propose_transfer then cancel_transfer. The sequence proves Idle -> PendingTransfer -> Idle.
